author: Ankit
problem: Return the average of a product's star ratings rounded to one decimal place, or 0.0 if it has no ratings.
bug_description: Divides with // instead of /, so the average is rounded down to a whole number before rounding to one decimal.

comments.accurate: Average star rating, rounded to one decimal place
comments.wrong_behavior: Average star rating, rounded down to a whole number of stars
comments.wrong_location: Averaging verified; check that the no-ratings case returns a float
